verdict.rationale: ClickUp's MCP docs explicitly say a connected AI assistant can create status updates and portfolio summaries from tasks and docs, but that route needs an external AI client. Native Brain² is only described generically as seeing tasks, docs and conversations in real time and answering complex questions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a native in-product AI status-update feature, explicit grounding in 'recent activity' (time-windowed changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
